subject: possible shiny server init script correction?

messages.author: e569f9ca5b5a4235
messages.subject: possible shiny server init script correction?
parts:
Following these instructions:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Ubuntu-step-by-step-install-instructions 

For me, the reference upstart script doesn't start shiny server at boot:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/blob/master/config/upstart/shiny-server.conf

I replaced "start on stopped networking" with "start on started networking" and it worked.  Perhaps I'm missing something since I'm not a sysadmin, but it seems like I want shiny to start once networking is started; networking won't be stopped on boot.

Anyways it worked for me.  At some point I will learn how git works so I can contribute back to this incredibly useful package, but for now I wanted to let someone who knows git about this potential fix.

Would it be possible for you to create an issue on our GitHub page for this? In looking at it a little further, I'm not convinced that we've seen this issue before, so I want to make sure we're able to get things working as expected on your distribution/version.

You can create an issue here (https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/issues?state=open) and that will allow us to follow up with you a bit more easily (and without spamming too many people's inboxes any further than I already have).

Thanks!
